title: A new area for the first time in years. The "rusty shipyard"?
content: All my mallworld locations have been recurring since i was about 14. The typical ones mentioned like hotel, hospital, weird tunnels, an odd playground/waterpark combo, mansion in the woods, but this was a whole new area in just as much detail. I'm kinda shocked because i did not expect it last night and nothing crazy has happened in my life lately. It was this odd rusty shipyard place where i was walking along this boardwalk side path to see it. It was like some sort of museum or preservation but the pieces of metal were SUPER rusted. I assume this was salt water because the corrosion and the smell, i was looking upon what was like typical battleships in the distance and closer to the path were smaller rusted out yacht sized ships and then just random weird bent out pipes or tubes or some debris type of metal there. Almost like if a giant jungle gym was destroyed in lava or something and then rusted to hell. Hard to explain. I dont know what they were, but felt overwhelmed in sadness when i saw them and thought of Germany for no reason i can think of. After that i continued up the boardwalk to this sort of area that had plastic airport style seats but it wasnt an airport, it felt like maybe some intake or ticket door to the building ahead and there was a line of many people. I was just waiting in line when suddenly the storm sirens went off and a giant tornado formed across the entire sky right in front of us behind the big building. I held onto the chairs that were bolted down on the side and most of us were fine, there was just some minor panic. (Storms are common in my personal mallworld so this isnt surprising to me.) And then i just waited and i woke up. The detail on that rusty shipyard has me stunned. I kept thinking in the dream that the rust flakes were super knarly and it had to have been there for such a long time with no *real* maintenance so what kind of damn "museum" is this?!
